notes.title: Calm Skies Trailerblazer Edition Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello Everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve been hard at work for the last few months to bring you a huge update for Calm Skies. We are calling it the TRAILBLAZER EDITION. Here are some of the things you can expect to find:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]New dashing mechanic has been added to flying[/p][/*][*][p]New power-ups added to spice up the gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Flying as a whole has been revamped, you can look forward to better animations and flying feel[/p][/*][*][p]Terrain generation has been revamped, and it should be much more enjoyable to fly through[/p][/*][*][p]Models have received a fresh coat of paint and should look better than ever[/p][/*][*][p]Shaders have been improved for performance[/p][/*][*][p]Object spawning has been redone to be more interesting to fly through[/p][/*][*][p]Refreshed the UI to make it more readable[/p][/*][*][p]Full leaderboard functionality, you can now organize by game mode, and by friends and global scores[/p][/*][*][p]Improved lighting[/p][/*][*][p]Some new cheat codes to find[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We want to thank you all for playing Calm Skies and hope you have enjoyed flying with us. If you have any feedback or would like to reach out to us, you can find us on our Discord: [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/aJQBxpR9fT"]https://discord.gg/aJQBxpR9fT[/url][/p][p]See you in the skies.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Calm Skies Sky Features Update V1.7!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45100304/2e88f2331f117746f3b051c918ad3fce679c87aa.png[/img]
Hello Everyone! Today we’re bringing a brand new addition to every biome, Sky Features! Each biome will now have unique objects flying through the sky, ranging from planes to a witch on a broomstick. Explore the skies and see what each biome has to offer.

Keep an eye on the horizon, as future biomes will also include sky features. We hope you enjoy this update and that it brings more life to the skies!

Changes:
[list]
[*] Sky features added to each biome
[*] Main menu hover text updated
[*] New cheat codes
[*] Fixed a player mesh issue
[/list]
That’s all for now, but we can’t wait to bring you guys more stuff soon! As always, if you would like to give us your feedback you can join us on our discord at:

https://discord.com/invite/aJQBxpR9fT


See you in the skies!

Flashblack Games

(The screenshot is using the new plane cheat code)

notes.title: Calm Skies New Canyon Run Mode Update V1.6!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45100304/68a246560a9d0cb1d9b3a727f70350d7396d4baf.png[/img]

Hello Everyone! We heard you and we listened, so today we are bringing you a whole new way to enjoy Calm Skies. We have added a new Canyon Run mode to the game. In this new mode, you must stay below the canyon's height as you fly through twisting and diverging paths. If you dare to fly fast, your reactions and thinking must be sharp to keep up with the unpredictable turns. We hope you guys have as much fun playing in this new mode as we did!

Changes:
[list]
[*] A whole new game mode, Canyon Run! Stay below the canyon's height as you fly through the twisting and diverging paths!
[*] Improved the player animation while boosting.
[*] Fixed a small bug with the player leaderboards if the name was too long.
[/list]

We haven’t added a leaderboard to the new mode yet because we want to get the first round of feedback. We are looking forward to hearing from you and improving the new game mode. 

That’s all for now, but we can’t wait to bring you guys more stuff soon! As always, if you would like to give us your feedback you can join us on our discord at:

https://discord.com/invite/aJQBxpR9fT

See you in the skies!

Flashblack Games

notes.title: Calm Skies QOL Update V1.5
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! We are bringing you a small QOL update today.

Changes:
[list]
[*] A flying sensitivity option has now been added to the settings menu
[*] A new how-to-play graphic has been added that explains the challenges in further detail
[*] A small motion sickness improvement, last update we added a very slight camera tilt that worked well in 1st person, but with the new lower sensitivity option, this induced motion sickness in 3rd person. So we have now removed the slight camera tilt from 3rd person.
[/list]

That's all for now, we are working on a new game mode and other updates that we hope to share with you soon. Hopefully, this makes the game even more enjoyable.

See you in the skies!

notes.title: Calm Skies A New Perspective Update V1.3!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! Today we are bringing you a first-person mode in Calm Skies. We had a lot of fun flying around in first-person so we hope you do as well. Also, we have made the UI much more customizable! You will find a UI settings button in the settings menu where you can turn off the individual elements of the UI to your liking.

Changes:
[list]
[*] A whole new perspective! First-person mode added
[*] UI customization settings added
[/list]

That’s all for now, but we have another update in the pipeline, which should come out soon! As always, we would love to hear your feedback, and if you would like to give it to us, you can join us on our discord at: https://discord.com/invite/aJQBxpR9fT


[b]See you in the skies![/b]

notes.title: Calm Skies Ghost Biome Update V1.2!

Changes:
[list]
[*] A whole new Ghost Biome! With new trees, rocks, world features, rings and more!
[*] New customization options! Check out the 3 new matching helmets, bodies, and backpacks

That’s all for now but we can’t wait to bring you guys more stuff soon! We would love to hear your feedback, and if you would like to give us your feedback you can Join us on our discord at:

https://discord.com/invite/aJQBxpR9fT


See you in the skies!

notes.title: Calm Skies Content and Features Update V1.1!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! Thank you all for a wonderful launch! Today we are bringing you some hot and fresh updates. Some of them are from the direct feedback we got from our players, so if you have any ideas or suggestions please reach out to us on Discord using the link below!

Changes:
[list]
[*] Challenge System reworked to be streak-based. You can now complete challenges without having to finish a run. Now you can spend even longer flying through the mountains while still making progress.
[*] Added a challenge progress icon to let you know when you are making progress on your current challenge without having to pause the game to check
[*] Added your current high score to the main menu
[*] General UI updates
[*] Some small lore-related updates. Keep your eyes peeled as we continue to update the game. Although it’s still small for now, so don’t expect a whole story yet.
[*] New objects and features added for you to discover!
[/list]

That’s all the big changes for now. Looking forward to bringing you guys more stuff soon! If you would like to give us your feedback, we would love to hear it! Join us on our discord at: [url=https://discord.com/invite/aJQBxpR9fT]https://discord.com/invite/aJQBxpR9fT[/url]

See you in the skies, keep flying and enjoy the view!
